candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is uniform and clean across all views, with sharp edges and clear hardware details in the detail block.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing broad paint retention with irregular edge corrosion and rust runs, though the top face dust is slightly patchy.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a clean, consistent grey-green finish with well-defined vents and hardware.

locker_aged.explanation: The aged locker shows realistic weathering with rust concentrated on edges and hardware, matching the brief's requirements.

legacy_as_built.explanation: The legacy finish is a solid grey-green with a clean, unblemished appearance across all visible surfaces.

legacy_aged.explanation: The aged legacy finish displays appropriate wear with rust streaks and edge corrosion, though the interior wear is slightly more uniform than ideal.

grey-green_paint.observations: Consistent grey-green tone in as-built states across all blocks.

bare_hardware.observations: Hardware is visible and distinct in the detail block, appearing bare in as-built states.

dark_trim.observations: Dark trim is visible at the base of the lockers in the hero and front blocks.

edge_corrosion.observations: Irregular corrosion is clearly visible on edges and corners in the aged states.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow downward rust runs are present on vertical faces in the aged states.

settled_dust.observations: Soft dust is visible on upward-facing surfaces in the top block aged state.

faded_fabric.observations: No fabric pads are visible in the provided views.

findings: The dust on the top face in the aged state appears slightly patchy rather than uniformly soft.
The interior wear in the legacy aged state is slightly more uniform than the irregular wear seen in the candidate.
limitations: The detail block is cropped, limiting the view of the full hardware context.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected; wardrobe must also match or exceed its per-face finish in this review
